coverageBoundaries: No .secrets files, live private input directories, Docker data, environment credential stores or real credential values were read. Therefore this is a format/context scan, not equality comparison with live secrets.
All 303 unique images were recognized entirely on device using Apple Vision, covering all 526 pending image paths by SHA256. No images or OCR were uploaded externally.
Initial sandboxed OCR failed generically on 303 images. A local unrestricted single-image probe succeeded, followed by the successful 303-image batch. CPU-only sandbox retry also failed.

OCR is imperfect: Chinese labels sometimes misrecognized, small or low contrast text may be missed. No full-resolution pixel review through an external model was performed. No claim of zero possible image leakage is made.

Four unique credential table screenshots contain nonsecret Access Key identifiers and Secret last-four columns, not a detected one-time full Secret. Matching DOM capture text supports the table context.
Eight generated/symlink/binary artifacts are excluded rather than credential-cleared.

Existing committed history, already tracked files outside the pending inventories and performance raw diagnostics are outside this delegated review. GitHub empty secret-scanning alerts are not evidence for custom credential absence.
Eligible means no blocking credential evidence found for the inventoried bytes. Private operational logs/data remain local under exclusion rules; release packaging must use an explicit allowlist.

P4 supplemental review explicitly covers all 79 docs/acceptance, deployment and work-package4 evidence paths added by commit a0e828a64f427715abfbd7e8268c37b27ec231ea, including 58 full text files and 21 local-OCR images. Other committed history remains outside this review.
methods: UTF-8 full file scan: JWT, Bearer, provider tokens, private keys, credential assignments, connection passwords, credential URIs, cookies, custom platform prefixes
Supplementary sensitive-key adjacency and high-entropy token contextual classification
On-device Swift Vision accurate OCR in English and Simplified Chinese with SHA256 deduplication
